content: <thought>To propose a one‑step synthesis, I will look for a retrosynthetic template that converts a ketone and an acyl chloride into a β‑keto‑ester (the target). This matches a typical acylation of a ketone enolate with methyl chloroformate. I will search the template catalog for a reaction that breaks an acyl chloride and forms a carboxylic ester.</thought>
